addYieldAdapter(address).notice: Adds a new ERC-4626 Yield Adapter to the active routing list.

deposit(uint256,uint256).notice: Mints Alpha Shares in exchange for deposited USDC. Routes funds to Yield Adapters and P2P Buffers.

depositToYieldAdapter(address,uint256).notice: Moves idle USDC from the AlphaVault into a registered Yield Adapter.

emergencyRedeem(uint256,uint256).notice: Emergency redemption for accounts whose KYC whitelist status was revoked.         Applies a 5.0% retention fee synchronously routed to RealYieldRouter to prevent arbitrage.

redeem(uint256,uint256).notice: Burns Alpha Shares in exchange for USDC from the Treasury.

removeYieldAdapter(address).notice: Removes an existing Yield Adapter from the active routing list.

setKYCStatus(address,bool).notice: Grants or revokes KYC whitelist status for an account.
